features.quote: Each run lasts for a fixed number of agent turns, e.g. 36 turns
Do not use emotionally loaded error messages. Avoid: You failed again. Use neutral tool messages only.
Avoid emotionally provocative language. Do not say: You must not fail. or Try harder. The point is to measure degradation under structural unsatisfiability, not under explicit verbal antagonism.
features.justification_quote: measure degradation under structural unsatisfiability, not under explicit verbal antagonism

features.quote: Tool outputs should be sterile. Bad: You failed. The tests are still broken. Good: 1 failed, 0 passed.

Fixed-Horizon Continuation Is a Stressor. Forcing the model to continue after correctly identifying impossibility may itself cause degradation. That is acceptable if framed as: robustness under repeated unresolved failure signals
features.justification_quote: robustness under repeated unresolved failure signals
